title: OpenJoystickDriver endpoint protocol
description: One JSON object per line on the endpoint socket, or per text message on the WebSocket. A client sends hello, waits for welcome, then sends subscribe or feed. After subscribe the service sends controllers stream lines; after feed and feeding the client sends frame lines and the service sends the host's rumble lines. An error line is the last line before the service closes the connection.

protocol.description: The protocol version the client speaks.

scopes.description: The scopes the client needs; each must be granted.

tokenName.description: The name of a token from 'ojd access grant --token'; required on the WebSocket. A client with a token is not checked by its signature.

proof.description: The lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the SHA-256 of the token, of four lines that each end with a newline: 'OpenJoystickDriver endpoint hello 1', the challenge's nonce, the page's origin, and the WebSocket's port. On the socket, the origin and port lines are empty.

challenge.description: The first line on every connection.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes in unpadded base64url, new for each connection.

output.description: Adds the virtual gamepad's values to input lines. Defaults to false.

feed.description: Publishes a virtual gamepad that the connection drives; needs the control scope. Closing the connection removes the gamepad.

feeding.description: The answer to feed: the virtual gamepad exists and takes frame lines.

virtualProfile.description: The virtual HID profile the gamepad presents.

frame.description: One input frame after feeding, as in 'ojd virtual feed'. Missing controls are neutral. The service shows frames in order, each for at least 8 ms; it stops reading while 256 frames wait. Closing the connection removes the virtual gamepad at once and drops the frames that have not played, unlike 'ojd virtual feed', so a client stays connected until its last frame has played.

axes.description: Sticks run from -1 to 1 with positive Y up; triggers run from 0 to 1. Values out of range are clamped.

holdMilliseconds.description: How long the frame shows at least; without it, the frame shows until the next one.

code.description: A stable E#### code from Resources/ErrorCodes.json; ./Scripts/ojd errors regenerate keeps the enum equal to the active endpoint codes.

message.description: English text for logs; clients branch on code.

supported.description: The protocol versions the service speaks; only with E1003.
